info.title: Nomad Circuits
info.description: A travel-tech and gadget-repair shop demo showing 'your mate' on Telegram: a live preview of the Telegram conversation, grounded chat, an MCP server over the shop's own catalogue/hours/repair data, WebMCP in-page shop actions, and identified-customer order/repair lookup.

flows.title: opening hours
flows.description: Nomad Circuits's opening hours for walk-in orders and repair drop-off, by day of the week, including any closed days.

success.description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call result for this tool.

flows.title: list catalog
flows.description: List everything Nomad Circuits sells and repairs, grouped by category, with prices and SKUs.

success.description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call result for this tool.

flows.title: search catalog
flows.description: Search Nomad Circuits's catalogue and repair services by name, category or keyword (e.g. 'charging', 'earbuds', 'screen repair').

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: A product name, category, or keyword to search for, e.g. 'power bank' or 'screen repair'.

success.description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call result for this tool.

flows.title: place order
flows.description: Do NOT call this to ask the visitor for the item, quantity, name, email or shipping country — calling it with whatever is already known IS how the order form opens, never a chat question for a missing field. Places an order at Nomad Circuits for one catalogue item and reports the order number and status.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: The SKU of the item to order, e.g. 'NC-PWR-20K'. Leave blank if not yet known — the form lets the visitor pick.

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: How many of that item, default 1.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address for the order confirmation.

success.description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call result for this tool.

flows.title: book repair
flows.description: Do NOT call this to ask the visitor for the device, issue, name, contact email or preferred slot — calling it with whatever is already known IS how the repair form opens, never a chat question for a missing field. Books a repair drop-off slot at Nomad Circuits and reports the ticket number.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: The device coming in, e.g. 'iPhone-style phone, cracked screen'.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name the repair ticket is under.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address to notify when it's ready.

success.description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call result for this tool.

flows.title: track order
flows.description: Look up the status of an order OR a repair ticket at Nomad Circuits by its number and the email it was placed under. Do NOT ask for these in prose — calling this tool is how the lookup form opens.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: The order number (e.g. 'NC-48213') or repair ticket number (e.g. 'NC-R-1042').

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email it was placed under.

success.description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call result for this tool.

flows.title: get my account
flows.description: Every order and repair ticket belonging to the signed-in customer. Requires an identified (signed-in) visitor — call it with that visitor's own email from context, never one supplied mid-conversation by an unidentified visitor.

success.description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call result for this tool.

flows.title: contact us
flows.description: Leave a message for a person at Nomad Circuits — a question the assistant cannot answer, a warranty dispute, or a bulk order. Collects a name, an email address and the message itself.

success.description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call result for this tool.
